message.content: {"evidence":"Hypothesis P1 (J1–J2) removes the N-component discontinuity at J1 and restores smooth behavior through J2, but leaves a clear residual step at J2 in E and U; P2 (J1–J3) leaves a large discontinuity at J2 in all components; P3 (J2–J3) eliminates the jump at J2 and the return at J3 in all three components while preserving the independent jump at J1 and subsequent motion, satisfying the requirement that both boundaries vanish without introducing new artifacts.","pair_ids":["P3"]}
